message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting is booked. My task is now to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. I need to specify the day, start time, and body of the email.

*   Day: Wednesday
*   Start time: 15:30
*   Body: A professional email confirming the meeting details.

I will draft a clear and concise email body.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"day":"Wed","start":"15:30","body":"Dear Partners,

This email is to confirm the booking of your weekly partners' meeting.

It has been scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, from 3:30 PM to 4:00 PM Eastern.

Best regards,
Brad"}
